text: Aaron Gordon was given a double technical in the fourth quarter against Golden State on Oct. 26 and exited the court. He had seven points. He played 25 minutes.
He had 15 points, four rebounds and five assists in 29 minutes Friday against Phoenix.
The show said Aaron Nesmith is slowly ramping up. He started and played 30 minutes Sunday against Brooklyn with 11 points.
Aaron Nesmith returned to the starting lineup Wednesday at Memphis and scored 16 points in 30 minutes, including the late three that sealed the win.
Aaron Wiggins has scored in double figures in all six of Atlanta's games this season while coming off the bench. He has done it with hot 3-point shooting and very few free-throw attempts.
Aaron Wiggins had 10 points, a steal and a block in 23 minutes Saturday, and the show said his value depends almost entirely on scoring.
Aaron Wiggins played 24 minutes off the bench on November 2 and scored seven points. He has played 23 or 24 minutes in each of his last four games.
Aaron Wiggins is averaging 25.6 minutes and 13.8 points off the bench for Atlanta.
Aaron Wiggins has come off the bench in every game and played 29 minutes Wednesday with Jalen Johnson out, scoring 15 points. His value comes mostly from points.

Ace Bailey gets a big boost with Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic out and Lauri Markkanen and Jaxson Hayes questionable. He played 34 minutes on Oct. 26 and started and played 40 minutes on Oct. 28.
Ace Bailey played 40 minutes Wednesday with Utah missing several starters and scored 19 points with six rebounds.

Ace Bailey should see extra usage with Jaren Jackson Jr. out and Lauri Markkanen and Jaxson Hayes banged up. Keyonte George and Darryn Peterson are the only other Utah players looking for shots if Markkanen sits.
Ace Bailey played 37 minutes as a starter and has been playing heavy minutes since Jaren Jackson Jr. went down. He had nine points, seven rebounds, two steals and three blocks Saturday.

Bailey averaged 30 minutes and about 1.6 blocks per game through Nov. 2, and he played 40 and 37 minutes in the first two games after Jaren Jackson Jr. went down. The show said his field-goal shooting has been poor during that stretch.
Aday Mara has seen his minutes rise with Chet Holmgren out, and he played 28 minutes on Saturday with nine rebounds and four blocks alongside Isaiah Hartenstein.

Mara played a season-high 28 minutes off the bench Saturday and had 7 points, 9 rebounds, 3 assists and 4 blocks. He had played 20 and 21 minutes in the two prior games without Holmgren, and the show said the jump came largely from playing the final stretch of a blowout loss.
Mara is averaging 5.8 points, 5.0 rebounds and 1.8 blocks in 18 minutes per game over six games. The show said his usage is very low and his value comes mainly from blocks.

Aday Mara played 20 minutes off the bench Monday and had 10 points and nine rebounds. The show expects Oklahoma City to keep using two-big lineups, with Jaylin Williams, Mara and Isaiah Hartenstein all getting minutes.
Aday Mara is getting more playing time off the bench with Chet Holmgren out. He has played 20 to 28 minutes in each of his last four games, including 10 points and nine rebounds Monday.

Aday Mara started alongside Isaiah Hartenstein on Wednesday as Oklahoma City used a big lineup against Cleveland. He had nine points, five rebounds and three blocks in 25 minutes, and the show thought the move was matchup-based.
Adem Bona played just four minutes on Oct. 28 with Joel Embiid back.
Adem Bona played 25 minutes on Oct. 25 the last time Philadelphia started Dean Wade with LeBron James at center. He could see a bigger role Saturday if James and Jabari Walker are unavailable.
Adem Bona started Saturday with Joel Embiid resting and played 22 minutes. The show said he is a blocks option whenever Embiid sits a back-to-back.
AJ Dybantsa made his first NBA appearance and started on Oct. 28. He scored 19 points with two rebounds and two assists in 27 minutes on a 27 percent usage rate.
Dybantsa shot well in his season debut but seemed frozen out at times by the other high-usage players on the team. His usage and minutes are the thing to watch in his second game Friday, Oct. 30.
AJ Dybantsa played 27, 30 and 33 minutes in his first three games, and the show said his minutes limit keeps rising. He scored 21 points Monday while Alex Sarr was out.

AJ Dybantsa has started all three games he has played and is averaging 19.0 points, 5.0 rebounds, 1.7 assists and 1.3 steals in 30 minutes with about 30.1 DraftKings points per game. His minutes have risen from 27 to 30 to 33, and the show said his usage rate is about 25.5 percent.
AJ Dybantsa had nine points, six rebounds and three assists in 32 minutes on November 4. The show said he carried a 28% usage rate in his first two games back.
The show said AJ Dybantsa is off his minutes restriction. He has played 30, 33 and 32 minutes in his last three games.
Ajay Mitchell had six points and a steal in 26 minutes Saturday after early foul trouble.
He had 20 points, five rebounds and a block in 35 minutes as a starter Monday. The show expects him to keep the role because no returning player is likely to take his job.
Mitchell has started every game since Oct. 26 and played 32 to 35 minutes in his last two games, scoring 20 and 23 points. The show said Alex Caruso's return should not cut into his role much.
Horford has more of a role because Golden State is short on big men and Steve Kerr has stopped playing some of his other options.
Horford played Sunday but came off the bench for 9 points and 5 rebounds in 22 minutes. The show expects him to sit Monday.
Al Horford sat Monday, Nov. 2, for rest on the second night of a back-to-back, not an injury, and is available Thursday.
Alex Caruso returned from injury on Wednesday and played 20 minutes off the bench.

Caruso returned on Nov. 4 after missing four games and played 20 minutes off the bench with seven points. The show said he should carve out his own role with Cason Wallace and Jalen Williams likely out for the season and Chet Holmgren sidelined.

Alex Morales, a two-way player, played 14 minutes on November 2 after not playing on November 1, and he played 9 and 7 minutes in the two games before that. He has been part of the rotation with Jalen Suggs out.
Alex Sarr has played between 23 and 26 minutes in every game this season.

Alex Sarr played 29 minutes, which the show called his season high, but he managed only three points, eight rebounds and four turnovers. The show said Anthony Davis is soaking up most of the big-man work.
Alex Sarr played only 23 minutes on Wednesday but posted 11 points, nine rebounds, two steals and a block. The show said his minutes have stayed low this season.
He is questionable with left knee soreness, and Deandre Ayton started at center in his place Monday and played 24 minutes.
The show said Sarr is a risk to sit one game of the Wizards' Friday-Saturday back-to-back.
Allen Graves has been productive in limited minutes and could see a few more with Kawhi Leonard out. He is not expected to go far past 20 minutes.
He sat Wednesday with low back soreness, and Steven Adams (calf) and Marcus Smart (forearm) were also out. Fred VanVleet scored 24 as Houston moved to 5-0.
Alperen Sengun is questionable tonight at Dallas with low back soreness after sitting Wednesday. Fred VanVleet scored 24 with Sengun out and is off the report for the first night of a back-to-back.
He missed Friday with low back soreness, and Clint Capela started at center with 11 rebounds and five assists in 30 minutes. Houston has not posted its injury report for Saturday yet.
Alperen Sengun played 39 minutes on Wednesday and had a triple-double with 17 points, 12 rebounds and 10 assists. The show said Houston has been limiting minutes for most of its other players.
Amen Thompson blocked Victor Wembanyama at the rim to win Houston's game against San Antonio on Oct. 23. He had 20 points, 10 rebounds and two blocks.
He played 39 minutes at Dallas on Friday and had 15 points and six assists.
He had 14 points in 25 minutes Monday. The show said he is the one Rocket who looks out of sync in the current lineup.
He returned Wednesday and had 18 points and 14 assists in 35 minutes, and he runs the offense with Haliburton out.
He had 22 points, nine assists and five three-pointers in 30 minutes Friday at Miami. His production is boosted while Tyrese Haliburton is out.
The show said Andrew Nembhard's usage has been very high since Tyrese Haliburton went down. He had 23 points, four assists and four three-pointers in 35 minutes Sunday against Brooklyn.

In three games from Oct. 28 to Nov. 1 after Tyrese Haliburton went down, Nembhard averaged 21.0 points, 9.0 assists and 3.3 threes. The show said his usage and free-throw trips are up even from last season.

Andrew Nembhard is averaging 18.5 points and 7.3 assists in about 33 minutes, and the show said his usage is well above its projection with Tyrese Haliburton out. In the three games without Haliburton since October 28, Nembhard has averaged 21 points, 9 assists and about 39 DraftKings points, compared with about 28 DraftKings points in the three games they played together.
Andrew Nembhard returned to the lineup Wednesday at Memphis and scored 22 points in 38 minutes.
Andrew Wiggins took few shots and finished with 12 points in 30 minutes, and the show said he looks like the odd man out on offense right now.
He is averaging 27.3 minutes and only 3.0 rebounds per game. The show said the emergence of Pelle Larsson has cut into his playing time.
He started Monday but had seven points and no rebounds in 24 minutes. The show said Pelle Larsson and Klay Thompson are taking more wing minutes.

Andrew Wiggins is struggling, and his minutes have come down to 24 on November 2 and 23 on November 4. The show noted Miami has played Pelle Larsson ahead of him while Klay Thompson's minutes have risen.
Andrew Wiggins had three points and four rebounds in 23 minutes on Wednesday, and the show said he can probably be dropped.
Wiggins started but played only 21 minutes Thursday and had 2 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists. The show said his usage was about 15 percent and he is not fitting well with Giannis Antetokounmpo.
Anfernee Simons should get more shots if Jaylen Brown, Joel Embiid and LeBron James sit. He scored 21 points with five 3-pointers in 31 minutes off the bench Friday.
Anfernee Simons has been productive off the 76ers' bench, scoring 20, 21, and 19 points in his last three games. He hit five or more threes in each of those games.
Anfernee Simons has made five or more 3-pointers in each of his last three games.

Anfernee Simons scored 20, 21 and 19 points with 16 combined 3-pointers in three straight games from Oct. 28 to Oct. 31. He then fell to six points Monday and zero points in 10 minutes Wednesday off the bench.
Black moved into Orlando's starting five on Oct. 28 and played 31 and 33 minutes in his last two starts. He averaged 16.5 points, 4.8 rebounds and 4.8 assists in his four games through Nov. 1.

The show said Anthony Black's production is boosted while Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs are out. Black is averaging 16.5 points, 4.8 rebounds and 4.8 assists with about 33.4 DraftKings points per game, including 31 and 33 minutes in his last two games.
Black moved back into Orlando's starting lineup Thursday in place of Jamal Cain. He had 10 points, 7 rebounds, 6 assists and 5 turnovers in 31 minutes on poor shooting.

Davis was added to the injury report as questionable after spraining his ankle on Nov. 4, when he played through it for 30 minutes with 26 points and 10 rebounds. The Wizards play five games in seven nights starting Friday, including a Friday-Saturday back-to-back.
He is questionable Friday at Atlanta with an ankle sprain that he played through Wednesday, when he scored 50.5 DraftKings points.
Edwards is out after knee surgery, and the show said Minnesota's added usage goes mainly to Ayo Dosunmu and Jonathan Kuminga. He has not played since Oct. 26.
The show said Asa Newell would get more playing time if Jalen Johnson sits, and he could be a candidate to start. Newell played 19 minutes off the bench on Oct. 31 with 13 points.
The show said Newell left the Nov. 4 game with a toe issue. He played 10 minutes in that game.

Ausar Thompson returned from an ankle injury Tuesday and started, which moved Daniss Jenkins to the bench. He fouled out in 25 minutes with 11 points, six rebounds, two steals and a block, with most of it coming in the fourth quarter.
Ausar Thompson started and fouled out in 25 minutes Tuesday.
Ausar Thompson had 7 points, 9 rebounds and 8 assists in 29 minutes on Oct. 28. He returned to an on-ball role after spending more time spotting up in the corner two games earlier.
Ausar Thompson's minutes have been held down by an early injury, foul trouble, and a blowout. He played 33 minutes in the opener but has not topped 29 minutes since.

Ausar Thompson's steals and blocks are down to about 1.6 steals and 0.8 blocks per 36 minutes, from roughly 2.7 to 2.8 steals per 36 over the past two seasons. The show expects those numbers to rise and noted he is playing more minutes.

Ausar Thompson played 34 minutes on Nov. 4 with 11 points and 17 rebounds, and he played 33 minutes on opening night. The show said his minutes are up about two per game from last season, though he played only 26 minutes in two lopsided games.
Ausar Thompson is averaging 4.7 assists, one steal and 0.6 blocks over seven games. The show said his rebounding is up partly because Jalen Duren is out and may drop when Duren returns.
Austin Reaves had high usage on Oct. 28 but scored only 16 points with six rebounds on 6-of-16 shooting. He took only four free throws.
Reaves played 39 minutes Sunday against Toronto and scored 19 points; the starters had to come back in the final minutes after Toronto cut a 16-point lead to five.
He scored 27 points with five turnovers in 34 minutes Monday. The show said he is averaging about 4.6 turnovers per game.
Austin Reaves had 21 points and four assists in 37 minutes on Wednesday with no turnovers.
He started and had 15 points, seven rebounds, two assists and a block in 30 minutes Friday against the Clippers.
Ayo Dosunmu started Saturday with Anthony Edwards out and had 27 points, nine rebounds, three assists, three steals and two three-pointers in 38 minutes.
Dosunmu has started every game since Anthony Edwards last played on Oct. 26, playing 30 to 38 minutes in those four games through Nov. 2. He came off the bench in all four games before that.
He had 19 points, 12 rebounds and eight assists in 37 minutes Monday. The show said he should produce big numbers with Anthony Edwards out.
Ayo Dosunmu scored 21 points in 34 minutes as a starter Wednesday at Houston.
His usage is down early, and he is being used more as a stretch big on the perimeter next to Giannis Antetokounmpo.

Bam Adebayo scored 24 points with nine rebounds and three steals in 33 minutes Wednesday. His usage had been down early in the season, and he got more involved when Giannis Antetokounmpo landed in foul trouble.

He had 16 points, nine rebounds, two steals and two blocks in 31 minutes Monday. The show said his usage is down to about 21.7 percent from about 25 percent last season and that his steal rate is likely to fall.
Bam Adebayo has scored at least 40 DraftKings points in four straight games. He posted 35 points and 10 rebounds for 57 DraftKings points in 41 minutes Wednesday.
Adebayo had 18 points and 10 rebounds in 33 minutes Thursday.
He started Monday with Paul George out and had 11 points, five rebounds and three made threes in 27 minutes.
Baylor Scheierman played 29 minutes off the bench on Wednesday with Jayson Tatum out and Payton Pritchard leaving early, posting nine points and 11 rebounds.
Ben Sheppard is having surgery Wednesday to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee.
Ben Simmons is out for the season.
Bennedict Mathurin is barely playing off New Orleans' bench.
The show said Stirtz started the second half for the Thunder on Nov. 4. He played 22 minutes off the bench with 16 points and four threes.
Bilal Coulibaly moved to the bench when AJ Dybantsa entered the starting lineup on Oct. 28. He still scored 17 points with two steals and two blocks in 27 minutes.
He scored one point in 22 minutes off the bench Friday against Charlotte. With AJ Dybantsa back, he projects as a 22-to-24-minute bench player.
The Clippers signed Blake Wesley to a 10-day contract using a hardship exception because of their injuries.
Portis has dropped under 20 minutes a night, playing 17 and 18 minutes in his last two games before Nov. 4. The show said he can still be a fill-in when Bam Adebayo or another big sits.
Bobby Portis is playing a bench role for Miami, but his minutes have dipped from 24 on October 26 to 18 on Monday.

Bobby Portis played 21 to 27 bench minutes in most early games, but he has played 17 or 18 minutes in his last three. He scored 25.5 DraftKings points with 10 rebounds and 5 assists in 18 minutes Wednesday.
Portis played 14 minutes Thursday and went scoreless with 5 rebounds. The show said he was playing about 24 minutes a night early in the season.

Bogdan Bogdanovic scored 16 points with two rebounds, four assists, two steals and four threes in 15 minutes on Oct. 28 against his former team. He got extra minutes and 22 percent usage with players out.
Bogdan Bogdanovic played 19 minutes Saturday and did not make a three-pointer.

Bones Hyland was among the first three players off the bench on Oct. 28, along with Terrence Shannon Jr. and Joan Beringer. He scored 13 points in 16 minutes with a 28 percent usage rate and played some shifts alongside LaMelo Ball.
Bones Hyland has taken some minutes from Terrence Shannon Jr. He scored 19 points with eight assists in 20 minutes on October 30.
Bones Hyland has not played more than 20 minutes in any of his last four games, but he scored at least 22.75 DraftKings points in three of them.
Braden Burries is playing only about 15 to 17 minutes a night.
Indiana rested its regulars Monday, and he played 42 minutes with 19 points, 10 assists and three steals.
Braden Smith started for Indiana on Wednesday and played 24 minutes.
Bradley Beal (knee) has not played yet this season and is still recovering.
Brandin Podziemski had only 12 percent usage on Oct. 28 as Yaxel Lendeborg and Stephen Curry took most of the shots. He had eight points, five rebounds and six assists with no steals or blocks.

Brandin Podziemski played 37 minutes and had 17 points, eight rebounds and eight assists Sunday against the Clippers without Stephen Curry. The show said Curry's return for the next several games will cut into his and Yaxel Lendeborg's production somewhat.
Brandin Podziemski is playing close to 30 minutes a game or more, and the show said he gains value whenever Stephen Curry misses time.
Podziemski had 9 points, 6 rebounds, 3 assists, a steal and a block in 32 minutes Thursday.

Brandon Ingram (heel surgery) and Bradley Beal are out again for the Clippers. Darius Garland is playing through a back issue, and Keaton Wagler has played 25 to 28 minutes off the bench in each of his last three games.
Brandon Ingram remains out after heel surgery. The show said it has heard he is close to returning but does not believe it.
Brandon Miller scored 19 points with seven rebounds and three threes in 37 minutes, but the show said he shot poorly in Charlotte's 79-point game.
The show said Brandon Miller is running about a 40 percent usage rate and taking close to 30 shots a night. He has scored 24 or more points in five of his last six games.
The show said Brandon Miller's role will take a small hit as Coby White ramps back up. He scored 17 points in 31 minutes Monday.

The show said Miller ranks sixth in the NBA in usage rate and has taken at least 10 threes in all eight games, but he is hitting only about 29% of them. He scored 34, 39 and 31 points in a three-game stretch from Oct. 24 to Oct. 28, but has scored 19, 24 and 17 since.
Brandon Miller played only 26 minutes Wednesday at Brooklyn, down from about 35 a game, and scored 10 points.

The show said Brooklyn doubled Brandon Miller in the season opener and expects aggressive coverage on him Wednesday. It also said Detroit blitzed him on November 2, when he scored 17 points in 31 minutes.

Over his last eight games since Oct. 23, Miller has averaged 32.5 minutes, 22.5 points, 5.6 rebounds, 2.5 assists, 3.0 threes, 1.2 steals and 0.8 blocks. The show said he has shot about 36 percent from the field over the last two weeks.
He had nine points in 17 minutes off the bench Friday against the Lakers. He would likely move into a 26-minute role if Stephen Curry were injured.
The show said Brandon Williams gets more minutes when Stephen Curry sits. When Curry missed Oct. 24, Williams started and scored 20 points in 24 minutes.
Williams played 25 minutes off the bench Sunday with Curry and Green out and scored 17 points. He had played between 14 and 17 minutes in the three games before that.
Brandon Williams missed Monday, Nov. 2, with a left quadriceps bruise and is available Thursday against Miami.
Williams played 21 minutes Thursday, more than De'Anthony Melton's 17. He had 10 points, 4 assists and 2 blocks.
Brayden Burries scored 14 points in 21 minutes off the bench Saturday.

Burries moved into the starting lineup on Nov. 2 and played 26 minutes. Before that he averaged about 17 minutes, 8.9 points and 4.4 rebounds with no blocks, and the show expects limited usage next to Jaime Jaquez, Tyler Herro and Ryan Rollins.

Brayden Burries has started Milwaukee's last two games, taking Ryan Rollins's starting spot. He had nine points, five rebounds and three assists in 22 minutes on November 4 and has scored at least 20 DraftKings points in four straight games.
Brice Sensabaugh scored 12 points with two three-pointers in 19 minutes off the bench Saturday.
He had 13 points, six rebounds and a block in 21 minutes off the bench Friday at Minnesota.

Brook Lopez has come off the bench in all five games and averages 22.6 minutes, and he soaks up extra center minutes when Isaiah Jackson gets in foul trouble. He had 17 points and 11 rebounds in 27 minutes in the opener when Jackson played only 15.
Brook Lopez played 19 minutes off the bench Sunday against Golden State. The show said the game was close to a blowout, with about six minutes of garbage time.
Lopez scored 17, 22 and 15 points off the bench in his first three games but has scored 2, 13 and 7 in the three since. He has played between 19 and 23 minutes in each of those last five games.
Lopez started on Nov. 2 and posted 12 points and six rebounds in 22 minutes. The show said Yanic Konan Niederhauser is coming back soon, which would squeeze Lopez's role longer term.

Brook Lopez started at center for the second straight game on Wednesday and had 20 points, eight rebounds and two blocks in 35 minutes. He played 22 minutes in his previous start, and the show said he fouled out of that game.
Bryce Hopkins moved out of the starting lineup on Oct. 28 after playing about 35 minutes in the previous game. He played 14 minutes off the bench and scored zero points.
Cade Cunningham scored 30 points with four threes in 39 minutes on Oct. 28. He has been taking a lot more threes over his last few games with Jalen Duren out.
He had 20 points, five rebounds and four assists in 28 minutes Friday against Brooklyn. Detroit pulled its starters late in the win.
He scored a season-high 33 points on 13-of-20 shooting with seven assists, five steals and five rebounds Monday at Charlotte, playing 27 minutes and sitting the whole fourth quarter of a blowout.
Cade Cunningham had 26 points, 11 assists and seven rebounds in 40 minutes Wednesday against Philadelphia.
Martin started for Dallas on Nov. 2 and played 21 minutes. He returned to the bench on Nov. 4.
Caleb Wilson played 31 minutes as a starter in a blowout loss and had 23 points with six threes, two blocks and four assists.

He played 34 minutes Monday and scored 24 points with seven rebounds, four steals and four made threes. Box scores show he has played between 31 and 38 minutes in every game, and the show said Chicago keeps him on the floor even in blowouts.
The show said he has taken a large share of Chicago's shots, at about 18 attempts per game. He is averaging 21.2 points in 34 minutes per game.
The show said about 42 percent of Caleb Wilson's shots have come at the rim. Wilson scored 23 points with six threes in 31 minutes on Oct. 30.
Caleb Wilson played only 22 minutes in Wednesday's blowout loss. The show said this was the first blowout in which Chicago cut his minutes.

Caleb Wilson has averaged 32.5 minutes over Chicago's eight games, and the show noted that the Bulls keep giving him big minutes even in blowout losses. His lowest total was 22 minutes in the Nov. 4 game.
The show said Caleb Wilson has a usage rate of about 26 percent, which it said has cut into the usage of everyone else on the Bulls.
Cam Johnson was out on Oct. 28 and is expected to return fairly soon.
Cam Spencer started in place of Ty Jerome and had 10 points, five rebounds and 13 assists in 25 minutes. The show said he is a strong fill-in whenever Jerome sits.
Ty Jerome and Scotty Pippen Jr. are both questionable Saturday against Sacramento. Spencer has moved ahead of Pippen in the rotation and had eight assists in 23 minutes Thursday.
Spencer started on Oct. 31 with Ja Morant out and had 13 assists. In bench games he has played about 19 to 23 minutes with seven or eight assists in his recent outings.
Cam Spencer has seen more playmaking work with Scotty Pippen Jr. out, including 13 assists in a start on October 31. The show said he becomes a strong option whenever Ty Jerome or Pippen misses time.
Cam Spencer had nine assists in 24 minutes off the bench on Wednesday while getting extra backup point guard work with Scotty Pippen Jr. out.
Cameron Boozer has played the most minutes on Memphis with a 25 percent usage rate and about 16 rebound chances per game. He has produced close to 1.2 fantasy points per minute.
Cameron Boozer has been flirting with triple-doubles, including 18 points, 12 rebounds, and 12 assists on October 29. The show said Memphis is the last undefeated team.
He played one minute in a recent game, and the show said the Lakers are still trying to find ways to use him.
Cameron Carr made his debut Sunday and played 1 minute late in the game without scoring.

Johnson returned from a three-game absence with an ankle sprain and started on Oct. 30, posting 12 points, 9 rebounds, 3 assists and 1 steal in 34 minutes. He started again on Nov. 2 and played 34 minutes.
The show said Cameron Johnson left an earlier game early and has only played four games, so his minutes sample is small. He played 30 minutes on Wednesday.
The show said Wallace is presumably out for the season. He has not played since Oct. 25.
Cedric Coward has played in four of Memphis' five games and is averaging about 29 minutes. He has been playing power forward minutes when Cameron Boozer slides to center.
Cedric Coward scored 23 points with nine rebounds, four assists and four steals in 33 minutes on November 4. The show said he took 19 shots, including 12 threes, after several low-volume games.

Johnson, a two-way player, has been a regular part of the rotation at about 21 minutes a game, averaging seven points and four rebounds. He should get 15 to 20 minutes with Brooklyn's center group struggling.
Johnson started again but had only 2 points and 2 rebounds in 31 minutes.
Charles Bassey played only two minutes on Oct. 28.
Charles Bassey started Sunday and had 6 points, 10 rebounds, a steal and a block in 20 minutes. The show said he would be worth rostering at 22 to 24 minutes a night.

Charles Bassey played 20 and 23 minutes in Golden State's last two games, but those came with Stephen Curry and Draymond Green out on November 1 and with Al Horford, Brandon Williams and Gui Santos out on November 2. With the roster healthier he played 9, 2 and 2 minutes, and he played only 2 minutes on October 28 when Santos alone was out.

Bassey is averaging 11.5 minutes, 6.8 points, 5.0 rebounds and 0.7 blocks over six games. The show is unsure whether Steve Kerr will keep him in the rotation or start him at center with Gui Santos out.

Bassey had 8 points, 7 rebounds and 3 blocks in 14 minutes off the bench Thursday, with much of it in garbage time. The show said he is best used as a streamer when Al Horford or Draymond Green is out.
He is out 8 to 10 weeks with a small patellar tendon tear, so Isaiah Hartenstein and Aday Mara take on the frontcourt minutes.
Chet Holmgren is out eight to 10 weeks with a small patellar tendon tear and will not need surgery. He has not played since Oct. 25.
The show said Youngblood will have to play more minutes because Portland is out of healthy wings and guards.
Christian Anderson would be the likely backup point guard if Dennis Schroder sits, but he has played only 9 to 16 minutes in each of his games.
Christian Braun scored 31 points with seven 3-pointers on Oct. 30 and has had at least two steals in five of his six games. The show said his steals pace is not sustainable.
Braun has averaged about 36 minutes a night, and DeMar DeRozan's arrival has not cut into his role. He has averaged about 2.3 steals, which the show expects to come down somewhat.

The show said CJ McCollum's minutes have been up and down, and he played 31 and 24 minutes in his last two games. The show said McCollum, Aaron Wiggins, Nickeil Alexander-Walker and Dyson Daniels would all gain value if Jalen Johnson sits.

CJ McCollum had 13 points, nine rebounds and 12 assists in 32 minutes Monday with Jalen Johnson out. The show said he has had about a 31 percent usage rate since Atlanta acquired him at last season's trade deadline.
CJ McCollum moved to the bench on Wednesday while Kingston Flemings moved into the starting lineup. The show said McCollum ran a usage rate of about 26 percent in the bench role.
CJ McCollum had 15 points, five rebounds, five assists and two steals in 25 minutes off the bench on Wednesday.
Clint Capela did not start on Oct. 28 even with Alperen Sengun and Steven Adams out. He had 10 points, eight rebounds, three steals and two blocks in 22 minutes off the bench.
He started at center with Alperen Sengun out Friday against Dallas and had five points, 11 rebounds, five assists, two steals and two blocks in 30 minutes.
Capela started and played 30 minutes on Oct. 30 with Sengun out, but he went back to a 10-minute bench role when Sengun returned Saturday.
Capela started on Oct. 30 with Alperen Sengun and Steven Adams out, but he is now out himself. He missed Nov. 2 with a right ankle sprain.
The show listed White as out, but he started for Charlotte on Nov. 2 and played 16 minutes, which moved Dennis Schroder to the bench.
Coby White was hit in the eye on Wednesday but returned to the game, finishing with 18 minutes. The show said he is still ramping up after missing time.
Coby White has started both games since returning from his calf strain and played 16 and 18 minutes. Dennis Schroder moved to the bench when White returned.

Collin Gillespie had 16 points, 10 assists and four steals in 33 minutes off the bench. The show said reports out of Phoenix say the team wants a true point guard, and Gillespie is the only one on the roster.
He came off the bench Monday and played 24 minutes with three points. Box scores show he played 33 minutes off the bench in the previous game, and the show said he does not need to be rostered.
Collin Gillespie's bench minutes have been uneven, ranging from 21 to 33 this season. He played 24 and 23 minutes in his last two games and scored 11.75 DraftKings points in each.

Gillespie had 6 points, 2 rebounds, 2 assists and 3 steals in 24 minutes off the bench Thursday on another poor shooting night. The show said he likely needs Devin Booker or Dillon Brooks out to do more.
He started Monday with Jakob Poeltl out and had 18 points, seven rebounds, two blocks and a three in 28 minutes. Box scores show it was his first start and his highest minute total of the season.
Collin Murray-Boyles has started the last two games ahead of Jakob Poeltl. He played only 23 minutes on November 4 because the game was a blowout.
The show said Murray-Boyles should get a lot more work if Scottie Barnes sits Friday.
Collin Sexton scored 21 points with four three-pointers in 21 bench minutes Wednesday with Luka Doncic out. He is still on a minutes cap.
He scored zero points in 16 minutes off the bench Friday at Golden State. The Lakers' bench scored only seven points in the game.
Collin Sexton scored 14 points in 19 minutes off the bench Sunday.
Cooper Flagg played 33 minutes in a blowout win Wednesday and had 26 points and eight assists, while most other Dallas players stayed in the 20s for minutes.
He had 17 points, four rebounds, six assists, two steals and six turnovers in 40 minutes Monday. The show called it a down game after a hot shooting start.
Cooper Flagg played 40 minutes on Wednesday and had 19 points, 10 rebounds and five assists.
Cooper Flagg has not made a three-pointer in his last three games, though he played 40 minutes in each of the last two.
